technique_name: What methods can be used to improve the accuracy of machine learning models?
description: There are several methods that can be used to improve the accuracy of machine learning models, such as data augmentation, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, model ensembling, and transfer learning. Data augmentation involves creating more data points by manipulating existing data, while feature engineering involves selecting and constructing features that are useful for the model.
